reserves.name: Australian-dollar reserves in designated bank accounts

sources.label: Aura Partners AUDX Limited Assurance Report - May 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The May 31, 2026 report records AUD 4,018,780.50 in designated reserve bank accounts against AUDX 4,008,056 of reported supply. Aura Partners independently confirmed the reserve balances directly with the relevant financial institutions and reconciled them to the issued supply; the institutions and account-level allocation are not disclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: AUDX reserve verification subject to Aura Partners limited assurance as of May 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report establishes that the full reserve is held in designated bank accounts, but does not name the financial institutions or disclose provider shares and deposit terms.
